**Indikator 4a** is a central safety-related healthcare quality indicator in Denmark that measures the proportion of patients diagnosed with atrial fibrillation ([[atrieflimren]]) who receive indicated anticoagulation therapy ([[antikoagulationsbehandling]]) one, two, and five years after their diagnosis [^src1] [^src4]. Managed by the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] under the [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] (RKKP), the metric is critical for preventing thromboembolic complications such as stroke [^src1] [^src5].

### Clinical Definition and Methodology
The indicator specifically tracks patients who have a clinical indication for anticoagulation, which is defined by a [[cha2ds2-vasc|CHA2DS2-VASc]] score of ≥2 [^src5]. To calculate the metric, data is drawn from the [[landspatientregisteret|Landspatientregisteret]] and the [[laegemiddelstatistikregisteret|Lægemiddelstatistikregisteret]] [^src5] [^src9]. A significant methodological update took effect on January 1, 2023, when the SKS-code BFKB ([[b01af02|B01AF02]]) became the sole code capable of resulting in target fulfillment for the indicator [^src10]. The established national standard and development target for Indikator 4a is ≥90% [[standard-90-percent|Standard: ≥90 %]] [^src2] [^src4] [^src8].

### Performance and Regional Variations
National performance has shown a continuous upward trend in anticoagulation persistence since 2016, reaching its highest recorded levels in recent years [^src5]. For the reporting period of July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, the national fulfillment rate was 89.6% at one year [^src1], 88.2% at two years [^src8] [^src9], and 87.7% at five years [^src4]. While the national average hovers just below the 90% threshold, regional and local performances vary significantly. [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] consistently meets the standard, achieving 92.7% at two years [^src3] and remaining the only region to meet the ≥90% standard at the five-year mark (92.4%) [^src4]. At the hospital level, top performers include [[regionshospital-nordjylland-ven|Regionshospital Nordjylland Ven]] (93.6% at two years) [^src3] and [[aalborg-universitetshospital-thisted|Aalborg Universitetshospital Thisted]] (93.4% at five years) [^src4]. Conversely, institutions like the [[rigshospitalet|Rigshospitalet]] and [[garantiklinikken|Garantiklinikken]] have struggled to meet the standard, recording 84.3% and 53.8% respectively at the two-year mark [^src3].

### Broader Context and Patient Education
Recent evaluations have also intertwined the tracking of Indikator 4a with broader care initiatives, such as structured patient education. While the indicator for anticoagulation persistence is maintained, recent data highlights that only 19.2% of newly diagnosed patients received structured education within their first year, missing the 50% development target [^src10]. Regional and cluster-level variations in education are stark, with the [[midtklyngen|Midtklyngen]] in [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] reaching 62% [^src10]. To improve these metrics, hospitals like [[herlev-og-gentofte-hospital|Herlev og Gentofte Hospital]] have integrated group education into their standard workflows, utilizing the [[sundhedsplatformen|Sundhedsplatformen]] to automate referrals [^src10]. These efforts align with the [[esc-guidelines|ESC guidelines]], which increasingly emphasize patient education for newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation cases [^src10]. Patient representatives ([[afdk-patientrepraesentanter|Patientrepræsentanterne i AFDK]]) strongly advocate for these structured educational offerings shortly after diagnosis [^src10].

## Timeline

- 2016: Start på observation af stigende persistens til antikoagulationsbehandling [^src5]
- 2020/21: Tidligere år for indikator 4a-beregning [^src9]
- 2021-07-01: Start af måleperiode for indikator 4a (01.07.2021–30.06.2022) [^src8]
- 2021/22: Tidligere år for indikator 4a-beregning [^src9]
- 2022-06-30: Slut på måleperiode for indikator 4a (01.07.2021–30.06.2022) [^src8]
- 1. juli 2022: Start af indberetningsperioden for Indikator 3 og Indikator 4a i Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark [^src1]
- 2022-07-01: Start af rapporteringsperioden for Indikator 4a: 1. juli 2022 – 30. juni 2023 [^src1]
- 2022-07-01: Start af rapportperioden for Indikator 4a [^src1]
- 2022-07-01: Start af målingsperiode for Indikator 4a [^src9]
- 01.07.2022 - 30.06.2023: Aktuelle år for indikator 4a-beregning [^src9]
- 2023-01-01: Fra og med 1.1.2023 er det alene SKS-koden BFKB der kan resultere i målopfyldelse for indikatoren. [^src10]
- 30. juni 2023: Afslutning af indberetningsperioden for Indikator 3 og Indikator 4a i Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark [^src1]
- 2023-06-30: Afslutning af rapporteringsperioden for Indikator 4a: 1. juli 2022 – 30. juni 2023 [^src1]
- 2023-06-30: Afslutning af rapportperioden for Indikator 4a [^src1]
